$comment: Decision 0018 (gate G5). THE ARCADE MODIFIER, and the honest home of what used to be silent canon. Three knockdowns in a round stops the bout; four in a bout stops it. No professional rulebook has either, and this project used both as the termination condition in every measurement taken the week of 2026-08-03. Keeping them is a deliberate arcade choice - a bout that ends fast and reads clearly is worth having for exhibitions - and what changes is that choosing it is now visible in the header of every stream and every replay. The two numbers are the same ones condition_model.knockdown has carried since Phase N; a validator checks they still agree, so the legacy fields are a checked echo rather than a second opinion.
name: Project Uppercut Arcade Three-Knockdown Rule

referee_stoppage.note: Permitted but not modelled. Under this ruleset it matters less than under the professional one, because the knockdown counts end the bout on their own.

notes: For arcade exhibitions and special events. It may not silently define a professional fight - that is the whole point of Decision 0018.
